lines.zh: 嘶嘶作响，锐利爪子轻扫地面。
lines.en: Sssss, sharp claws scrape the ground.
Lower head to search, eyes sharp.

lines.zh: 尾巴左右摇摆，保持平衡。
lines.en: Tail sways side to side for balance.

lines.zh: 发出低沉咆哮，警告入侵者。
爪子收着走，落地才出声。
lines.en: Claws kept up, noise only on landing.

lines.zh: 咀嚼猎物，发出满足的声音。
沿着岩壁攀爬，敏捷地移动。
我踩着小碎步穿过蕨丛。
lines.en: I trot through the ferns on quick little steps.
My sickle claw lifts half an inch off the ground.
A flick of tail feathers and I turn, speeding up.

lines.zh: 我沿河岸留下三趾的脚印。
lines.en: I leave three-toed prints along the riverbank.
Stretches limbs, basking in the sun.

lines.zh: 发出轻微嘶鸣，放松身体。
lines.en: Makes a soft hiss, relaxes body.

lines.zh: 用爪子梳理羽毛，保持整洁。
目光空洞，漫无目的地走动。
警惕地环顾四周，准备出击。
lines.en: Nervously looks around, ready to attack.

lines.zh: 躺下休息，尾巴轻轻摆动。
lines.en: Lies down to rest, tail swaying lightly.

lines.zh: 盯着地面，寻找新鲜的踪迹。
lines.en: Stares at the ground, looking for fresh signs.

lines.zh: 发出尖锐的叫声，宣告领地。
lines.en: Makes a sharp call, claiming territory.

lines.zh: 我蹲下来，把头埋进羽毛。
lines.en: I crouch and tuck my head into my feathers.

lines.zh: 阳光晒热了我背上的羽毛。
lines.en: Sunlight warms the feathers on my back.

lines.zh: 我张嘴喘气，舌头轻轻抖。
我侧着头听林子的动静。
lines.en: I tilt my head and listen to the forest.
My screech comes before the strike.

lines.zh: 张开嘴巴，露出凶狠的牙齿。
尖啸一声，警示其他生物。
翅膀紧张地拍打，准备飞行。
尾部摆动，示意接近玩家。
lines.en: Tail swings, signaling to the player.

lines.zh: 低吼一声，表明自己的存在。

lines.en: Approach player, using claws to probe.

lines.zh: 发出警告声，防止玩家靠近。
lines.en: Make warning sounds to keep player away.

lines.zh: 紧张地盯着玩家，准备战斗。
lines.en: Stare intently at the player, ready for battle.

lines.zh: 我歪头把你从头看到脚。
lines.en: I tilt my head and look you over head to toe.

lines.zh: 眼睛上方的纹路竖起来。
lines.en: The crest above my eyes lifts.
Feathers flare. I shriek in pain.
My sickle claw is bent half an inch.
My leg is hurt, can't move...
The claws on my feet are still here.
That looks good enough to eat.
My claws will taste the prey.
The smell of meat opens my jaws.

lines.zh: 爪子一蹬，我整个人都飞起。
lines.en: One push of my claws and I leap.

lines.zh: 我的肩撞上了你的膝盖。
驰龙的尾巴横平，像根平衡杆。
lines.en: The dromaeosaur's tail levels out like a balance pole.
You're too weak, can't handle me.
Get back, or I'll get mad.
Before the leap, we size each other up.
Who wants to be with me?
I call my pack with a screech.

lines.zh: 我的爪子扣住地面，等你。
lines.en: My claws grip the ground, waiting.
We sharpen our claws side by side.
My teeth will feast on you!
I carry the bone back to the nest.
Swallowing you is like swallowing bones!

lines.zh: 我叼住你的袖子往后拖。
lines.en: I clamp your sleeve and haul backward.
My sickle claw digs into the dirt.

lines.zh: 瞄准了，这一扑带着尖叫。
lines.en: Aimed, and this pounce comes with a scream.
I hear breathing in the grass.
I lift my sickle claw, ready to spring.
I have spotted something that runs.
My eyes lock on your throat.
I hop onto a rock to look you over.
You have stepped into my hunting ground.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛盯着你的喉咙。
lines.en: My eyes lock on your throat.
I creep close in short steps.
Claws sink in first. Talk later.

lines.zh: 后爪抬起来了，你站得太近。
lines.en: My hind claw is raised; you stand too close.
Prey at the edge of sight!
I crouch low, tail feathers stiff.

lines.zh: 我一步步踩着你的影子。
lines.en: Step by step I tread on your shadow.
I whet my sickle claw in the mud.

lines.zh: 喉咙里的咕噜声越来越快。
lines.en: The rattle in my throat quickens.

lines.zh: 爪子先落地，再一口咬下去。
lines.en: Claws land first, then the bite.
Lacerate your flesh with my claws!
Crunch bones with my long beak!

lines.zh: 我一跃，镰爪扣进你的肩！
lines.en: I leap and hook my sickle claw into your shoulder!
I bite and wrench until you stagger!

lines.zh: 我的踢击划开你的小臂！
尾羽扫过你的脸，你后退！
lines.en: My tail feathers whip your face and you fall back!
I hatched covered in wet feathers.
I poke my head out from under the ferns.
A shriek cuts through the forest.
I shake the dirt off my back.
I slide down the rocky slope into the valley.

lines.zh: 三趾脚印先出现在泥上。
lines.en: Three-toed prints appear in the mud first.
I call once in the morning mist.
Crest raised, I claim this place.

lines.zh: 受伤了，真难受...，遭爆炸的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Wounded, this hurts — and the explosion makes it worse.

lines.zh: 镰刀爪还抬着，我还能跳。
lines.en: Sickle claws still raised; I can still leap.

lines.zh: 翅膀受伤了...，挨饿的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: My wings are hurt — and the starvation makes it worse.

lines.zh: 闪电把我的羽毛点着了。
